title: the countdown dollies in, the drop cuts low over the water
story: Countdown at 89 BPM with marching brass and hard drums (beat 21.54 ticks, bar 86.14). The pre-roll is a steady swell: the kicks shake the valley and the oleaje swell rises 0.5 to 0.8, the snares flash the sweep and the moon. On each of the four counts (bars 53-56) the camera dollies in on the downbeat and narrows its fov, then at the drop (4837) it cuts low over the water with foam, palette contrast and a hue step. After the drop the same carriers repeat and the camera cuts every two bars between low and mirrored stations, the prominent hits (4944-5002, 5311-5369) lifting the whole picture.
